description: This Java source file defines a final class 'MongoHealthChecker' that extends 'AbstractHealthCheckingActor'. Its purpose is to perform health checks on a MongoDB instance by inserting, querying, and deleting a test document, then reporting the status based on the success of these operations. It uses Akka actors and streams for asynchronous processing and interacts with MongoDB through reactive streams.

classes.name: MongoHealthChecker
classes.description: A final class extending 'AbstractHealthCheckingActor' responsible for checking the health of a MongoDB instance by performing simple insert/find/delete operations within an Akka actor context. It creates and manages a MongoDB client, runs health checks asynchronously, and updates health status accordingly.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Closes the MongoDB client when the actor stops, ensuring resource cleanup.

methods.description: Static method to create Props for actor instantiation.

methods.description: Defines message handling logic for receiving 'CurrentMongoStatus' messages.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Initiates a health check by attempting to insert, find, and delete a test document, then sending status update.

methods.name: generateStatusResponse
methods.description: Performs the actual MongoDB operations with reactive streams to determine if the database is responsive; returns a CompletionStage with an Optional error.

methods.name: applyMongoStatus
methods.description: Updates the overall health status based on the received 'CurrentMongoStatus'.
